crossRefs.note: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.
Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?

translations.web: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”
translations.bsb: For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned.”
translations.kjv: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
translations.asv: For by thy words thou shalt be justified, and by thy words thou shalt be condemned.
